# Compost corner ideas, gathered in one place

Several notes about a compost corner behind the shared beds turned out to
be circling the same handful of questions: how often to turn the pile,
whether food scraps need to be covered with leaves right away, and where a
second bin would fit without blocking the wheelbarrow path. Gathering them
here makes it easier to see what they have in common before picking one to
work on next.
